name: ColorPicker
label: Colour picker
description: Swatch trigger opening a saturation area, hue and alpha sliders, and a hex field; controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: label
props.description: Field label text

props.name: value
props.description: Current colour as a hex string — 3, 6 or 8 digit, with or without `#`

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial colour for uncontrolled use

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Convenience callback receiving the colour as an uppercase hex string
(`#RRGGBB`, or `#RRGGBBAA` when `showAlpha` and alpha < 100%). Fires
live while dragging.

props.name: showText
props.description: Show the current hex value as text inside the trigger

props.name: showAlpha
props.description: Add an alpha (opacity) slider and emit 8-digit hex when alpha < 100%

props.name: size
props.description: Component size

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the picker is disabled

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the field is required

props.name: error
props.description: Error state

props.name: helperText
props.description: Helper or error message

props.name: name
props.description:
When set, a hidden `<input type="hidden">` carries the current hex value
under this name so the picker participates in native form submission.

props.name: panelLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the open panel. Defaults to the field label followed by "colour picker", or "Colour picker" without a label.

props.name: saturationLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the saturation and brightness area.

props.name: saturationValueText
props.description: Spoken value of the saturation and brightness area, given both as whole percentages.

props.name: hueLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the hue slider.

props.name: alphaLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the alpha slider, shown with `showAlpha`.

props.name: hexLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the hex text field.

props.name: triggerLabel
props.description:
Accessible name of the swatch trigger when there is no visible `label`,
given the current hex value. Defaults to "Choose colour, " followed by the
hex (`Choose colour, #118AB2`). A passed `aria-label` still wins.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes — applied to the wrapper, not the trigger
